name: Glimmerwood Kin
author: Fourfold Community
description: Meet three new wild companions: the lantern-eyed Glimmerfox, the burrowing Mossling and the rideable Brackenback.

name: Shattered Meridian
author: Fourfold Community
description: A fifth, community-made realm of fractured crystal shelves and drifting monoliths. Explore its luminous ravines and challenge the Meridian Sentinel.

name: Astral Armory
author: Fourfold Community
description: A pair of dimension-forged weapons for high-risk expeditions: the Starfall Glaive and Riftglass Saber.

name: Windbound Vehicles
author: Fourfold Community
description: Craft two traversal upgrades: a wind skiff for open terrain and an Umbral strider for difficult ground. Select one and press R or V to ride.

name: The Cartographer's Lost Roads
author: Fourfold Community
description: A short side-story following the Pale Cartographer's abandoned trail. Recover a survey cache and piece together a route that predates the Sundering.

name: Echoes of the Heart Loom
author: Fourfold Community
description: A compact expansion bundle with a new echo-realm, a rare companion, a story quest and a relic weapon. A glimpse of how full community expansions can combine content types.
